name: Boss
source:
Susan’s temporary employer. He writes a Bi-Seasonal Newsletter for the residents and tourists of Fortune Island. He usually does all the work, but this time he hired Susan to write one of the articles. Boss is eccentric and gets a little too excited about being someone’s boss, which is probably obvious, considering he decided to call himself “Boss” for the day. He also tends to use cliched phrases that have been said a hundred times, and yet he always manages to get them wrong. He is also incredibly unhelpful when it comes to directing Susan in her job. At times, it seems as though he has set her up to fail instead of succeed. While this annoys Susan to no end, his actions truly have no ill intent.

[Edited from [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=43&t=23120]Lemma Soft WIP Thread[/url]]
